- SDK 403s now name the safe executor role, operation, and securable.
- User-executor errors identify the relevant OAuth scope when known (`catalog.catalogs`, `catalog.schemas`, `catalog.tables`).
- Service-principal errors provide qualified UC privilege/admin-grant guidance.
- No SDK exception text, token, host, or stack content is used.
- Added focused translation, remediation-difference, secrecy, lazy-call-context, and envelope tests.
